comparison.success_condition: PR scoring requires clip release before withdrawal, source disconnection, target insertion over 8 mm with under 1 mm lateral error and under 5° angle, hook retention, neighbors withdrawn no more than 8 mm, and 2 s hands-clear hold; candidate requires mass recovery, complete washer retention, no spill/damage/contamination and 3 s screen dwell.
comparison.reason: Connector unlatching and retained insertion test confined precision manipulation, not granular separation.
